response.sql: WITH c AS (SELECT p.fundflux AS fundflux, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM scanspatial s JOIN projects p ON p.arcregistry = s.arcref GROUP BY p.fundflux), t AS (SELECT CAST(SUM(cnt) AS REAL) AS total, AVG(cnt) AS avg_cnt FROM c) SELECT c.fundflux AS funding_source, c.cnt AS spatial_record_count, c.cnt / t.total AS share, c.cnt - t.avg_cnt AS excess_over_average FROM c, t WHERE c.cnt > t.avg_cnt ORDER BY c.cnt DESC

assumptions.assumption: Records are joined to projects with an inner join on scanspatial.arcref = projects.arcregistry. Unmatched records are dropped, as the request says.
A NULL fundflux is treated as its own group, so it counts as a source in the average and the total. The request does not say how to handle NULLs.
The share is a decimal fraction (0 to 1), not a percentage, and is left unrounded.

alternatives.interpretation: Exclude projects with a NULL funding source, so they do not count as a source in the total or the average.
alternatives.sql: WITH c AS (SELECT p.fundflux AS fundflux, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM scanspatial s JOIN projects p ON p.arcregistry = s.arcref WHERE p.fundflux IS NOT NULL GROUP BY p.fundflux), t AS (SELECT CAST(SUM(cnt) AS REAL) AS total, AVG(cnt) AS avg_cnt FROM c) SELECT c.fundflux AS funding_source, c.cnt AS spatial_record_count, c.cnt / t.total AS share, c.cnt - t.avg_cnt AS excess_over_average FROM c, t WHERE c.cnt > t.avg_cnt ORDER BY c.cnt DESC
